name: Glancing Arc
description: Set the lead foot long and the rear foot braced so the whole frame backs a throw of great reach.

name: Chimegrain
description: Narrow the eyes on a far mark and match its height to the wing tip before the arm moves.

name: Rumblecurve
description: Reach forward past the lead foot at release so the stick starts its flight a half pace farther out.

name: Verity Trailingedge
description: Trace the ground below the arc to find the lane the stick will take on its way home.

name: Scorching Cycle
description: Feed qi into the stick through the whole outbound leg so it reaches the far mark with spin undiminished.

name: Hoarfrost Return
description: Snap the stick into a tight turn at the far end so it falls back into the return lane at once.

name: Woodcuirass
description: Set the feet and stiffen the arm with qi to take a heavy stick returning from far off.

name: Gust Leadingedge
description: Cast to the edge of what qi can carry and strike a faraway mark both outbound and on the way back.

name: Siltwood
description: Let the returning stick sweep a wide arc over a crowded field and strike whoever stands in its line.

name: Waningbark
description: Stand still and let the qi field settle at arm's length so the stick's position is felt.

name: Nova Circling
description: Lean the body into the throw and let go as the shoulder reaches its lowest point.

name: Granite Loopback
description: Pace slowly around the thrower's circle so the stick's orbit never crosses your own feet.

name: Verity Woodgrain
description: Lift the open palm into the stick's path and feel its weight settle against the field.

name: Chime Curveback
description: Rotate the held stick edge-on to carry a thrust past the ribs and away.

name: Fortifying Wingarm
description: Seed the stick with a knot of field qi that holds it close to the thrower throughout its orbit.

name: Curvetorment
description: Send the stick in a broad ring about the body that lashes any foe standing inside the circle.

name: Charter Returnarc
description: Keep the stick circling the foe at head height until they crouch and cannot step forward.

name: Rumble Tipwing
description: Hold the stick in a long closed orbit within the qi field and strike through it again and again.

name: Facet Elbowbend
description: Cast the stick around a patch of ground until its circle marks a ring that punishes any who cross it.

name: Exacting Sweptwing
description: Draw the paths of two casts in the mind and note where they will cross over the foe.

name: Gust Crookend
description: Release a second stick a heartbeat after the first and a hand's width higher.

name: Torrent Trailingedge
description: Weave left then right between the two flights to stay clear of both returns.

name: Leadingedge Cloak
description: Drop the near shoulder and let the held stick slide a cut across it and off.

name: Facetwood
description: Throw two sticks on arcs that meet at the foe's guard from opposite sides.

name: Crippling Crookend
description: Close both sticks on a foe's weapon arm like a pair of shears and pin it.

name: Glint Returnarc
description: Let two returning sticks pass each other at the foe's body so their edges meet across it.

name: Noxious Tipwing
description: Throw several crossing arcs into a lane so any foe who runs through is struck from both sides.

name: Might Woodgrain
description: Fix one end of a thin qi line to the hand and the other to the stick before casting.

name: Glint Arc
description: Draw the arm back smoothly so the tether pays out evenly and never snags.

name: Might Hover
description: Hold the free hand out at the side so it can pull or push the tether during the flight.

name: Wingarm Linctus
description: Send tiny pulses down the tether and read what comes back from the stick.

name: Cyclesprint
description: Move a pace toward the stick's line to take up any slack in the qi tether.

name: Implacable Elbowbend
description: Whip the tethered stick back to knock aside a blow aimed at the thrower.

name: Sweptwing Barrage
description: Pull the tether sideways in flight and let the stick bank around the foe's raised guard.

name: Splintering Return
description: Tap the tether once to knock the stick off its line and onto a dodging target.

name: Fastening Hover
description: Wind the tether round a foe's ankle by steering the stick behind them and then pulling taut.

name: Glint Circling
description: Steer the returning stick into the back of a foe who has turned to run from it.

name: Grainthrash
description: Steer the stick after a moving target and keep adjusting its path until it strikes.

name: Soaring Loopback
description: Stand light on the balls of both feet with the wings of both sticks held tucked and level.

name: Chime Woodgrain
description: Draw a stick from each hip at once with both hands pinching their wing tips.

name: Facetgrain
description: Count one and let both sticks go together so the pair flies as a single beat.

name: Mindful Leadingedge
description: Fix an unwavering gaze on one point of the foe and hold it while the arms work.

name: Rousing Trailingedge
description: Take one returning stick in each hand at the same instant with both palms open.

name: Murk Returnarc
description: Turn a thrust aside with the crossed flats of both sticks held at the wrist.

name: Chimereturn
description: Throw both sticks on mirrored curves so they close on the same spot together.

name: Cleaving Crookend
description: Throw from a high crouch so the stick drops onto the target as a hawk drops on prey.

name: Toxin Elbowbend
description: Send one stick high and one low so the foe's guard splits and leaves a gap between.

name: Hoarfrost Tipwing
description: Bank the left stick left and the right stick right and bring both in behind the foe.

name: Wrecking Cycle
description: Close two sticks on a foe from either flank in the same moment and crush their guard between.

name: Returnassault
description: Cast the pair high and let them rake down across a crowded patch of ground together.

name: Waning Wingarm
description: Read the bend of the nearest river and bank the stick on the same line.

name: Blazebark
description: Hold two crescent sticks nested in one hand with their elbows touching.

name: Gust Curveback
description: Stand on the high ground and set the feet as if the foe sat in a dish below.

name: Keen Crookend
description: Look past the foe and watch them through the edge of the eye to hide the throw.

name: Gust Return
description: Cast two crescents that curve toward each other and meet at the foe's torso.

name: Rumblearc
description: Hold a steady flow of qi in the stick so it curls in a long bend around the foe.

name: Facet Loopback
description: Skip the stick off a far slope so it falls back down into the basin on the foe.

name: Tearing Circling
description: Let two crescents meet on the foe's weapon and strip it from the hand.

name: Insidious Returnarc
description: Cast crescents in a wide ring about a low patch of ground so any within feel their cut.

name: Nova Arc
description: Tilt the stick toward the sky at the instant of release and let it climb.

name: Verity Tipwing
description: Watch the dust and feathers drift upward to find where the rising air will lift the stick.

name: Torrent Hover
description: Sink low then rise onto the toes in one flow to launch the throw upward.

name: Waning Curveback
description: Close curled fingers on the stick like talons as it drops past the shoulder.

name: Gust Sweptwing
description: Sweep the forearm and stick together in a rising arc to push a blade up and over.

name: Woodgrain Onslaught
description: Send the stick up to a great height and let it drop in a long fall upon the mark.

name: Gyvecurve
description: Hook the stick's crook on a foe's collar or belt and haul them forward off their feet.

name: Chime Hover
description: Ride the stick on a rising current so it climbs over a wall of shields and falls behind.

name: Woodassault
description: Rise high on the outbound leg and plunge steeply on the return to hit with all its weight.

name: Elbowbend Tincture
description: Keep the stick circling high overhead and read through its flight what lies beyond the near ground.

name: Waning Trailingedge
description: Face the wind and name the direction the stick must leave the hand to bend home.

name: Silt Wingarm
description: Stand with the chest turned half into the gale and the throwing side kept clear.

name: Hoarfrost Sweptwing
description: Throw from the rim of high ground so the stick drops over open air before it turns.

name: Remnant Curveback
description: Take the returning stick in a hand held steady and pledged never to flinch from it.

name: Arctorment
description: Keep the cast on its chosen bearing with steady qi even as the wind shoves at the stick.

name: Ponderous Arc
description: Use a gust to swing the stick's crook around a foe's arm and tighten it.

name: Rumble Loopback
description: Throw along a sworn bearing so the stick strikes twice and returns exactly to the hand.

name: Mayhem Cycle
description: Cast the stick into a strong gust and let it sweep a wide field of foes at knee height.

name: Torrent Elbowbend
description: Set the feet on the edge of high ground and trust the toes to find solid stone.

name: Hovertorment
description: Draw in a slow breath while the arm rises and loose the stick as the breath leaves.

name: Chime Sweptwing
description: Squint across the wind and note how far it will push the stick off its mark.

name: Returnbarrage
description: Throw high into clear sky so no object blocks the wide turn of the return.

name: Gust Circling
description: Step toward the plateau edge so the stick's fall is over open ground and not behind you.

name: Unyielding Returnarc
description: Hold the stick up so a gust helps turn an incoming bolt wide of the body.

name: Rupturing Cycle
description: Throw an arc held steady by the thrower's resolve so the wind cannot bend it off the mark.

name: Harpooning Arc
description: Skim the stick along the edge of the plateau to strike a foe on the narrow ledge.

name: Murkgrain
description: Throw into the crosswind so the stick knocks an incoming missile out of the air.

name: Hollowcurve
description: Throw the stick on the wind with qi on its leading edge so it cuts through a raised shield.

name: Leadingedge Remedy
description: Hold the stick in the calm of a lull and read from its drift where the foes stand.

name: Restoring Tipwing
description: Feel the wind along the cutting edge and learn which way it will lean the throw.

name: Facetcycle
description: Throw low into a rising gust so the stick lifts into the foe's chest.

name: Racing Wingarm
description: Lean along the bearing of the wind and step with it so the body is never pushed.

name: Facet Circling
description: Roll the wrist in a set pattern at every cast so the stick answers the same way each time.

name: Murk Curveback
description: Take a cut on the shoulder-held stick and let the wind carry its force away.

name: Woodgrain Torment
description: Throw into the wind with the edge forward so the stick whistles and slices cloth and skin.

name: Chime Leadingedge
description: Let a rising current catch the stick and fling it back in a sharp hooked turn.

name: Hourgrain
description: Send the stick out and back in the gusts so a foe cannot rise from cover.

name: Rumble Return
description: Rake the whistling stick across a foe on the return and again as it spins out of reach.

name: Siltgrain
description: Throw several sticks on one bearing so a foe who crosses it is struck on every side.
